core_obligations: (1) iff (3): apply the weak characterization to every affine etale U -> X.
(2) implies (1): the U-lemma makes the fibre of |U| -> |X| over x finite; enumerate it and apply the R-lemma on one covering U_i to bound the fibres of |R| -> |X|.
(4) implies (3): Spec(k) x_X U is etale over k and quasi-compact over U, hence a finite disjoint union of spectra of fields.
(3) implies (4): Spec(k) -> X is quasi-compact by the quasi-compact-local lemma.
(4) implies (5) is an immediate weakening; (6) implies (5) is clear; (5) implies... handled by (4) implies (6): factor Spec(k') -> Spec(k) -> X and compose quasi-compact morphisms.
proof_roadmap: Bootstrap the six conditions through the three finiteness lemmas; quasi-compact transfer; factorization finish.
difficulty_reason: A six-way equivalence of point conditions bootstrapped through three carded finiteness characterizations with two transfer arguments of its own.
